manaNeeded: {4}{R}{R} at most plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
description:
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power if the spell had mana value 5 or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery.
Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve Reiterate, copying the instant or sorcery and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.
